name: Hiizumi Senji
source:
"I'm Senji Hiizumi, a detective in Sagami City. With how dangerous the world is lately, I can't afford to skip any patrols. My wife and daughter--who works overseas--are my pride and joy... heh."

A well-known, tough-looking detective in Sagami City. He's driven by justice but has a dangerous belief that anything goes when it comes to punishing criminals, which has pushed him to violence.

Still, he's incredibly sweet to his [url=/c160637]daughter[/url] and a devoted husband. Doesn't he have it way better than he deserves? Ha.

I just hope [url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url] never gets involved with the police.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category5&ch=senji]official website[/url]]
